newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc trade slowed by August 1 holiday.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc trade slowed by August 1 holiday.

text.p: 0720 GMT - Swiss banks and bourses were closed on Friday for Switzerland's August 1 national holiday, dampening trade in Swiss francs.
* The dollar outside Switzerland was quoted higher on Friday morning at 1.5174/84 Swiss francs versus Thursday's close of 1.5125/5135.
* The mark was quoted lower at 82.20/22 Swiss centimes versus 82.42/45 Swiss centimes at Thursday's close. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
